factors.hypothesis: A large signed close-to-close move, delivered as a full-bodied bar on exceptional volume, contains transient market impact that should decay.
factors.name: ORC_SIGNED_IMPACT_SHOCK_20

factors.hypothesis: Directional price discovery achieved without an extreme volume dislocation is less impact-driven and is more likely to persist.
factors.name: ORC_RETURN_PER_VOLUME_SURPRISE_20

factors.hypothesis: A signed short trend is fragile when absolute returns are tightly coupled to volume and volume itself is unstable, indicating concentrated liquidity impact.
factors.name: ORC_IMPACT_CONCENTRATION_20

factors.hypothesis: Exceptional volume combined with a lower-close candle indicates absorption or distribution that is more likely to be followed by a short-term fade.
factors.name: ORC_VOLUME_CLIMAX_10

factors.hypothesis: A directional return trend achieved with stable, orderly volume is more sustainable than the same trend delivered with unstable participation.
factors.name: ORC_VOLUME_STABILITY_TREND_20

protocol.discovery_scope: purged rolling train and validation folds only
protocol.locked_holdout_policy: Do not inspect or tune on the final chronological holdout until families, candidates, model, and strategy parameters are frozen; evaluate that holdout once.
protocol.multiplicity_control: Benjamini-Hochberg false-discovery rate at q=0.10 within the frozen catalog
protocol.primary_metric: mean validation daily rank IC in the declared direction
required_robustness_checks: same sign in a majority of validation folds
incremental result versus the unchanged Alpha158 baseline
positive net excess at the configured 10 bps slippage stress
no material concentration in one instrument or one fold
research-only classification while the ETF universe is not point-in-time
